demo.title: bdfx-discovery.sh
demo.code:
# Read current BDFX PWYW fee options. No wallet connection or funds required.
node scripts/connect.mjs fee-options

# Discover supported assets without creating an exchange.
node scripts/bdfx.mjs catalog

# In Bankr: "Review exchanging my Base ETH to Bitcoin through BDFX with a 0% BDFX fee. Show the quote before creating an order or sending funds."

setup: Install the BDFX skill; Node 18+ is required. Installation and fee/catalogue discovery need no API key or funds.
Start at https://bdfx.io/bankr or ask Bankr for a BDFX Base ETH to Bitcoin review, including the amount, Bitcoin payout address and PWYW fee.
Connect your own Bankr EVM wallet through the exact BDFX off-chain sign-in challenge. The helper stores a temporary, private credential file; never paste credentials into chat.
Approve one exact floating-rate order separately from payment. Payment requires existing Base ETH plus gas and a separate confirmation; swaps and shortfall funding are prohibited.
Current execution: native Base ETH to Bitcoin mainnet. Broader catalogue discovery is available; other execution adapters are not enabled.
